toolsPreview.name: register_provider
toolsPreview.description: Add or update an ICT third-party provider in the DORA Register of Information (Art. 28). Tracks all ITS-required fields: LEI, service type, criticality, data location, exit plan, etc.

toolsPreview.name: list_providers
toolsPreview.description: List all ICT third-party providers in the Register of Information with optional filters.

toolsPreview.name: get_provider
toolsPreview.description: Get full details, risk flags, and ITS completeness of a specific provider.

toolsPreview.name: validate_roi
toolsPreview.description: Validate entire Register of Information against DORA ITS requirements. Checks all mandatory fields, exit plans for critical providers, LEI coverage, etc.

toolsPreview.name: concentration_risk
toolsPreview.description: Analyze ICT concentration risks across providers, countries, cloud types. DORA Art. 29 requires assessment of ICT concentration risk.

toolsPreview.name: ctpp_check
toolsPreview.description: Assess if a provider might qualify as Critical Third-Party Provider (CTPP) under DORA Art. 31-44. CTTPPs face direct ESA oversight.

toolsPreview.name: export_its
toolsPreview.description: Export Register of Information in ITS-compliant format for supervisory reporting.

toolsPreview.name: gap_analysis
toolsPreview.description: Identify gaps in the Register — missing fields, incomplete entries, missing exit plans, LEI coverage issues.

toolsPreview.name: register_stats
toolsPreview.description: Dashboard summary: provider counts, criticality distribution, ITS field completeness, exit plan and LEI coverage.
